card.text: Sub-Neptune 2.4 times Earth’s radius, in the temperate zone of a red dwarf.

introduction.text: K2-18 b is 2.4 times as wide as Earth and circles its red dwarf every 33 days. Only its size and orbit are measured; here it is a plain gray sphere.

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A gray sphere of the measured radius. No colour, surface or atmosphere of this planet is observed.
